gen-press-start-2p-gf-orienta: Arcade fun, with curves that only reveal a slight swell up close, from Press Start 2P. But Orienta underneath keeps its counters hollow and its lowercase nearly capital height, so the heading's loudness has somewhere to settle.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-oxygen: Press Start 2P stamps out big open-looking bowls and a barely tapered stroke, pure retro play. Oxygen then takes over with curves that never fold back on themselves, and its lowercase nearly matches its capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-radio-canada-big: Playful retro, with just a light push between verticals and curves in Press Start 2P. Radio Canada Big follows with a monoline skeleton and a tall x-height, like glass tubing bent into letters.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-roboto: Roboto brings generous mouths on its round letters, a low-key counterweight to the retro heading. Roboto's best trick is keeping capitals close to lowercase height, which leaves Press Start 2P free to do the shouting.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-sintony: Big open-looking bowls give Press Start 2P its retro grin. Sintony's chunky, tall midzone is what ties it together, giving smooth, unclogged curves that make the heading's arcade whimsy easy to follow.
gen-righteous-gf-alexandria: Thin steel rod bent into every letter gives Righteous its commanding look. Alexandria handles the quiet work, with generous c terminals and a tall body carrying short stems above and below.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-gujarati: Fun and commanding, Righteous holds one track width throughout, like a neon sign tube. Anek Gujarati works the other side, with lowercase that rivals the capitals and a gaping c opening for approachable text.
gen-righteous-gf-georama: Georama reads approachable and unfussy, its c opened up like a bracelet pulled apart and its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Righteous supplies the flat, steel-rod punch up top.
gen-righteous-gf-hind-madurai: Thin steel rod seems bent into every Righteous letter, made for punch. Hind Madurai handles the finer work, its s curves opening wide at both ends and its lowercase filling the line like capitals.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoine: Righteous draws each letter like thin steel rod, every stroke carrying the same visual weight. And Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, with generous space where curves meet stems, keeps paragraphs moving without the heading's swagger.
